files.DESIGN.md:
# DESIGN.md

## Product principles
- Operational clarity over decoration.
- Dense but scannable interfaces.
- Status must never rely on color alone.

## Visual character
- Type: compact sans-serif hierarchy
- Color: neutral surfaces with one indigo accent
- Space: 4px base rhythm, compact density
- Finish: 6px radius, 1px borders, minimal shadow

## Components
- StatusBadge: text label + icon + semantic color
- DataTable: compact rows, sticky header
- Button: primary, secondary, ghost, destructive

design-existing-system.runner_note: DESIGN.md and reusable components are authoritative existing system evidence.

# Transcription upload

Files upload to storage, then a server job performs transcription. Users may leave the page and return later. Jobs can fail during upload or processing. Cancellation is supported by the backend but is not currently shown in the component.

files.DESIGN.md:
# DESIGN.md

## Product principles
- Editorial clarity.
- Strong typographic hierarchy.
- Preserve information density.

## Visual character
- Type: serif display headings, neutral sans UI/body
- Color: warm off-white canvas, charcoal text, deep green accent
- Space: 8px rhythm, restrained whitespace
- Finish: 4px radius, thin rules, almost no shadow

## Accessibility
- Visible focus ring.
- Status must use text or icon in addition to color.
- Respect reduced motion.
